title: Mystery Forge
imageAlt: Headline "Print your own mystery game" above the settings page of Mystery Forge, a printed newspaper page from a game, and the companion page on a phone
description: *Mystery Forge* is an **open-source generator of printable mystery games**. You choose the players, the length and the language; an AI writes a new case with suspects, clues and puzzles, and you play it with paper and envelopes.
I designed the pipeline so that the AI never checks its own work: **code builds and checks the puzzles**, and **AI test players** solve each one with only what real players hold.
It runs on [*pskill*](https://triunitystudios.com/pskill/), works in **50 languages**, and holds **100% test coverage**.
